question: A neutral gene mutation:

options.opa: Change a coding codon by another synonym without altering the amino acid sequence of the protein.
options.opb: A coding codon changes with a different one and the protein is functionally different.
options.opd: It changes the amino acid sequence of the protein without altering its function.
options.ope: Suppresses the effect of a previous mutation.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: A neutral gene mutation -> Change a coding codon by another synonym without altering the amino acid sequence of the protein -> 95% CHAIN: A neutral gene mutation -> May change a non-coding region without affecting protein function -> 80% CHAIN: A neutral gene mutation -> Can lead to a silent mutation -> 70% CHAIN: A neutral gene mutation -> May have no phenotypic effect -> 60% CHAIN: A neutral gene mutation -> Could potentially alter gene regulation -> 95%
